title: A review of methods for quantitative evaluation of spinal curvature

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《A review of methods for quantitative evaluation of spinal curvature》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The aim of this paper is to provide a complete overview of the existing methods for quantitative evaluation of spinal curvature from medical images, and to summarize the relevant publications, which may not only assist in the introduction of other researchers to the field, but also be a valuable resource for studying the existing methods or developing new methods and evaluation strategies.
